title: Priority claim: closed form and non-vanishing support for a half-horizontal-domino constrained tiling count on the 3-by-n board - Lean 4 formalized proof + claim note (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Claim of record (priority deposit): a claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the frozen Lean 4 statement snapshot, the complete machine proof (mathlib v4.34.0, 0 sorry, #print axioms within the standard whitelist), audit evidence (strict compilation log, byte-wise statement comparison, axiom printout, listing byte-exactness check) and the full C9 novelty-search record including every zero-hit query. The note is licensed CC BY 4.0 and the code MIT. This artifact was produced by the AI4Math highly-automated pipeline (LLM generation + Lean kernel adjudication). The object of the formalized results is the pure integer sequence b1(k) = 8^k * C(7k,k) on multiples of 8 and 0 elsewhere. Two honest limitations are carried in the note and the record: the OpenAlex literature channel was unreachable from the searching machine (Crossref substituted, so coverage is lower than in the screening batch -- a channel gap, not strengthened evidence), and a zero hit is not novelty. The kernel-level results are structural theorems about a pure integer object; the identification of that object with the constrained tiling count of the board is a combinatorial semantics bridge that is NOT proved and is stated only as a conjecture. No moment/expectation novelty is claimed.
